message: You're finally out of steam and resorting to personal attacks because you can't keep up with the facts. Let's get one thing straight: you're not a truth-teller, you're a hack who's been regurgitating the same tired, debunked talking points for years. Your entire argument has been a mess of straw men, red herrings, and outright falsehoods, and now you're trying to salvage what's left of your credibility by smearing me as a "charlatan" and a "menace". Well, let me tell you, sweetheart, you're the one who's been a menace to this conversation all along, peddling your simplistic, authoritarian nonsense and refusing to engage with any actual evidence or arguments. You don't belong in a serious discussion about drug policy because you're not serious: you're a joke, a caricature of a reasonable person, and a waste of time. Get out.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'hack', 'menace', 'joke', and 'waste of time', using insults and derogatory language to attack their character rather than their argument. 'You're the one who's been a menace to this conversation all along' is a direct personal attack.
